old_recheck.command:
PYTHONPATH=src:../orze/src CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib, subprocess, sys, types
from unittest.mock import patch
import pytest
gate = patch("orze_pro._gate.require_license")
gate.start()
for name, repository, revision, path in (
    ("orze.skills.loader", "../orze", "ac5500d9c1d75e936d96162e5897608164e30faf", "src/orze/skills/loader.py"),
    ("orze_pro.engine.role_runner", ".", "fc3ecea00dfbc1416586c7a23a613bb1048580c0", "src/orze_pro/engine/role_runner.py"),
):
    current = importlib.import_module(name)
    source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", repository, "show", revision + ":" + path], text=True)
    module = types.ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__ = current.__file__
    module.__package__ = current.__package__
    sys.modules[name] = module
    parent, leaf = name.rsplit(".", 1)
    setattr(importlib.import_module(parent), leaf, module)
    exec(compile(source, "frozen:" + revision + ":" + path, "exec"), module.__dict__)
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(["-q", "tests/test_skill_activation_dispatch.py", "tests/test_skill_native_gating.py", "--tb=short"]))
PY
